headlines.title: Estonia's defense agency takes Datasel dispute to Swiss arbitration
Estonia considers delaying Rail Baltica completion to 2034
International interest mounts in Estonian scientists' drug-detection meter
Estonia's Niina Petrõkina wins Bergamo figure skating round
Estonian experts say social media should be improved for children instead of banned

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Estonia's defense agency takes Datasel dispute to Swiss arbitration. [1]
Estonia considers delaying Rail Baltica completion to 2034. [2]
International interest mounts in Estonian scientists' drug-detection meter. [3]
Estonia's Niina Petrõkina wins Bergamo figure skating round. [4]
Estonian experts say social media should be improved for children instead of banned. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR ESTONIA
The Datasel dispute being taken to Swiss arbitration may affect Estonia's defense procurement or contractual relations. [1]
A delay of Rail Baltica completion to 2034 could alter Estonia's transport infrastructure timeline and associated funding. [2]

KEY RISKS
The arbitration process in the Datasel dispute could result in financial or operational consequences for Estonia's defense agency. [1]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the Swiss arbitration in the Datasel dispute remains unresolved. [1]
Whether Estonia will formally decide to delay Rail Baltica to 2034 is pending. [2]
